category_edits.rationale: Test exponent 0.4, between the incumbent square root and the previously tested fourth root. This slightly increases attenuation of middle-frequency training items across all four datasets. Preserve training-only counts, zero features for unseen items, maximum normalization, attenuation strength, and checkpoint-backed inference.

change_summary: Change the normalized training-frequency feature exponent from 0.5 to 0.4 for all four category models. Existing checkpoint buffers and predictor loading remain compatible.
